mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees and overcast by the Verona Public Library. The moon is in its third quarter phase. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has released updated permit processes for erosion control and stormwater management to ensure new developments meet our environmental standards. Also, please be aware that asphalt repairs are scheduled for November 9 and 10 on streets including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street.

There is a busy schedule ahead for Verona. Today, you can enjoy Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher special at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, the ART House 360 Thursday night festivities, or Hop Haus Trivia.
In a notable incident from October 23, two 13-year-olds were cited for riding eMotos after previously being warned that they were prohibited on city streets.
You are going to love today's flavor, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so you can satisfy your craving.
